message: Function has multiple exit doors — use single-exit control flow

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' has {count} exit doors — use single-exit control flow (e.g. a continue-flag pattern)

rationale: Multiple exit points create invisible control flow. A reviewer must trace every path to understand what the function returns. A single exit makes the return value the function's explicit contract. Language dunder methods and generators are structural language constructs, not application control flow.
remediation: Refactor to a single terminal return (or raise only if the language special method contract requires it). Prefer a continue-flag / staged assignment pattern for application logic.
